# Class 7 {.ct}

![](../graphics/REB_Logo.png){fig-alt="Reaction Engineering Basics Logo" fig-align="center" width="200"}

## Most Abundant Intermediate {.cc}

Class 7 describes the simplification of mechanistic rate expressions when one of the intermediates is present in much greater concentration that all others.

## Learning Outcomes {.ch}

After completing Class 7 you should...

* Know 
    * the definition of a most abundant intermediate
    * the inequality that applies to most abundant intermediates
* Understand
    * Some mechanisms do not include a most abundant intermediate
* Be able to
    * identify terms in a mechanistic rate expression that can be eliminated when there is a most abundant intermediate and simplify the mechanistic rate expression accordingly

## Prepare {.ch}

* Read Sections 4.6 and 4.7 and Example 4.8.6  from Chapter 4 of REB, The Book
* Watch the Class 7 Preparation Video
